dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage with gene therapy approach targeting Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency using TSRA-196.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently recruiting patients for Phase 1/2 trial evaluating TSRA-196 in adults with PiZZ genotype and associated lung/liver disease.
dossier.indications_pursued: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (AATD) with focus on patients with PiZZ genotype presenting with lung and/or liver disease manifestations.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of recruiting status for Phase 1/2 trial NCT07227207 evaluating TSRA-196 in AATD patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage company developing antigen-driven CAR-T (adCAR-T) expansion methodology as an alternative to traditional ex vivo and in vivo CAR-T approaches.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical data published in bioRxiv preprint demonstrating antigen-driven CAR-T expansion method that enables rapid, physiological CAR-T cell programming.
dossier.delivery_approach: Antigen-driven CAR-T expansion platform that bypasses manufacturing bottlenecks while avoiding systemic vector delivery risks associated with traditional in vivo approaches.
dossier.key_differentiators: Proprietary adCAR-T methodology that represents a third approach beyond conventional ex vivo and in vivo CAR-T therapies, designed to overcome manufacturing limitations and systemic delivery safety concerns.
dossier.last_significant_event: Publication of bioRxiv preprint in May 2026 describing the antigen-driven CAR-T expansion method and its potential to enable rapid, physiological CAR-T cell programming.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company with in vivo CAR-T approach using viral vector delivery platform.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently recruiting patients in Phase 1 dose-escalation study for lead asset UB-VV111, but no clinical data has been disclosed yet.
dossier.indications_pursued: Targeting hematologic malignancies including relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia.
dossier.delivery_approach: Viral vector-based delivery system as indicated by the UB-VV111 asset naming convention.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiated recruiting for Phase 1 trial NCT06528301 evaluating UB-VV111 in B-cell lymphomas.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing CPTX2309 for autoimmune indications. Specific in vivo delivery modality not disclosed in available data.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently recruiting Phase 1 trial (NCT06917742) evaluating CPTX2309 in healthy volunteers and patients with moderate to severe rheumatoid arthritis or systemic lupus erythematosus.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus. Focus appears to be on moderate to severe disease presentations.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 clinical trial NCT06917742 for CPTX2309, currently in recruiting status.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies. Lead asset KLN-1010 is currently in a Phase 1 trial for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: KLN-1010 achieved 100% overall response rate (ORR) in Phase 1 inMMyCAR study as presented at ASCO 2026. Data demonstrated maintained efficacy and durability profile in multiple myeloma patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Multiple myeloma, specifically relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma patients. Focus appears to be on hematological malignancies.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo BCMA CAR-T therapy platform targeting B-cell maturation antigen. Uses direct in vivo delivery approach rather than ex vivo cell manufacturing.
dossier.key_differentiators: Achieved 100% ORR in Phase 1 trial, which was described as exceptional by industry observers. In vivo approach eliminates need for ex vivo cell manufacturing process.
dossier.last_significant_event: Acquisition by Eli Lilly announced in June 2026, following positive ASCO 2026 data presentation showing maintained 100% ORR for KLN-1010.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early-phase clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies delivered via injection. Currently has 4 clinical trials with 3 actively recruiting patients.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Limited data disclosed as trials are in early exploratory phase focusing on safety, tolerability and initial efficacy. One trial has advanced to Early Phase 1 status (NCT07336823).
dossier.indications_pursued: Targeting hematological malignancies including relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Also pursuing refractory autoimmune diseases.
dossier.delivery_approach: Injectable in vivo CAR-T platform with assets JY231 (targeting CD19 for B-cell malignancies) and JY232 (targeting BCMA for multiple myeloma). One dual CD19/BCMA approach for autoimmune diseases.
dossier.key_differentiators: Injectable delivery format for in vivo CAR-T generation, potentially eliminating need for ex vivo cell manufacturing and processing. Dual-target CD19/BCMA approach for autoimmune indications.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of recruiting status for multiple clinical trials including NCT07336823 (JY232 for multiple myeloma) reaching Early Phase 1 designation.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with multiple trials using in vivo delivery approach for autoimmune diseases. Three active trials are currently recruiting or preparing to recruit patients.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: No clinical or preclinical data has been disclosed from the ongoing Phase 1 trials. One trial in refractory myasthenia gravis was terminated with no reported results.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including generalized myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and systemic sclerosis (scleroderma). The company has two distinct assets (HN2301 and HN2302) targeting these conditions.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 trial NCT07556120 for generalized myasthenia gravis with asset HN2301, listed as not yet recruiting.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early clinical stage with Swissmedic approval for first human trial of non-viral in vivo CAR-T therapy.
dossier.delivery_approach: Non-viral in vivo CAR-T delivery platform technology.
dossier.key_differentiators: Non-viral approach to in vivo CAR-T therapy, distinguishing from viral delivery methods used by competitors.
dossier.last_significant_event: Acquired Pantherna Therapeutics in June 2026 to accelerate clinical translation and received Swissmedic approval for first human trial.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company with gene therapy approach for X-linked chronic granulomatous disease using EN-374 asset.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently recruiting Phase 1/2 trial (NCT06876363) evaluating safety and potential efficacy of EN-374 in X-linked chronic granulomatous disease patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Primary focus on X-linked chronic granulomatous disease with EN-374. Previously pursued sickle cell disease and stem cell mobilization applications with MGTA-145 asset.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of recruiting Phase 1/2 trial for EN-374 in X-linked chronic granulomatous disease (NCT06876363).

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company with multiple in vivo CAR-T trials actively recruiting patients across oncology and autoimmune indications.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Three Phase 1 trials are currently active but not recruiting, evaluating safety, tolerability, and preliminary efficacy of SC262 and SC291 assets. No specific clinical data has been disclosed yet.
dossier.indications_pursued: Oncology indications include Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma, Large B-cell Lymphoma, and Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia. Autoimmune diseases include Systemic Lupus Erythematosus and other severe autoimmune conditions.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T cell therapy platform with assets SC262 and SC291, though specific delivery mechanisms are not detailed in available data.
dossier.key_differentiators: Developing hypoimmune cell therapy technology alongside in vivo CAR-T approaches. Pursuing both oncology and autoimmune applications with the same platform.
dossier.last_significant_event: Recent news report in June 2026 indicating in vivo CAR-T trials have started with data expected within 12 months, alongside advancement of hypoimmune cell therapy programs.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1-3 clinical development across multiple assets, with no disclosed in vivo CAR-T programs in available data
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 3 completion of Nefecon in Chinese IgAN patients and Phase 2 recruitment for EVER001 in kidney diseases
dossier.indications_pursued: Kidney diseases (IgA nephropathy, minimal change disease, primary membranous nephropathy) and solid tumors including squamous non-small cell lung cancer
dossier.delivery_approach: Oral BTK inhibitor (EVER001) and intramuscular administration (EVM14), with recent acquisition of VIZZ/LNZ100 rights for Greater China
dossier.key_differentiators: EVER001 is a highly selective, oral, reversible, covalent BTK inhibitor that acts on multiple immune pathways without directly affecting T cells or depleting B cells
dossier.last_significant_event: Acquisition of rights to develop and commercialize VIZZ (LNZ100) in Greater China from LENZ Therapeutics announced June 2026

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies using circular RNA delivered via lipid nanoparticles targeting T cells.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Two Phase 1 trials currently recruiting: ORN252 in healthy volunteers for safety assessment and TI-0032-III in relapsed/refractory autoimmune diseases.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and Sjogren's syndrome, with initial safety testing in healthy volunteers.
dossier.delivery_approach: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) that target T cells and deliver circular RNA encoding CD19 chimeric antigen receptor.
dossier.key_differentiators: Use of circular RNA technology for in vivo CAR-T generation rather than traditional ex vivo cell manufacturing approaches.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of two Phase 1 clinical trials, including first-in-human study of TI-0032-III in autoimmune diseases.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase I/II clinical stage company developing ex vivo CAR-T cell therapies. Currently has three active trials with OriCAR-017 for multiple myeloma and Ori-C101 for hepatocellular carcinoma.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Ori-C101 GPC3 CAR-T achieved 66.7% overall response rate in late-line hepatocellular carcinoma patients at ASCO 2026. This data supported progression to confirmatory Phase II trial with NMPA clearance in China.
dossier.indications_pursued: Relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma with anti-GPRC5D CAR-T (OriCAR-017) and advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with GPC3-directed CAR-T (Ori-C101). Focus on both hematologic malignancies and solid tumors.
dossier.delivery_approach: Ex vivo manufactured CAR-T cell products delivered as injections. Uses traditional autologous CAR-T approach rather than in vivo delivery methods.
dossier.key_differentiators: GPC3-targeting approach for solid tumor CAR-T with demonstrated 66.7% response rate in late-line HCC patients. Dual-asset portfolio spanning both liquid and solid tumor applications.
dossier.last_significant_event: NMPA clearance received in June 2026 for confirmatory Phase II trial of Ori-C101 in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma following positive ASCO data presentation.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical development with ex vivo CAR-T cell therapy approach. Company has at least one commercially available product (zevorcabtagene autoleucel) with post-marketing studies initiated.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: CT041 (anti-claudin18.2 CAR-T) has progressed to Phase 1b/2 trials in gastric adenocarcinoma and pancreatic cancer with active but not recruiting status. Zevorcabtagene autoleucel has received commercial approval for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
dossier.indications_pursued: Multiple solid and hematologic malignancies including gastric adenocarcinoma, pancreatic cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, and relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. Focus spans digestive system cancers and blood cancers.
dossier.delivery_approach: Ex vivo autologous CAR-T cell manufacturing and infusion approach. No in vivo delivery technology identified in available data.
dossier.key_differentiators: Targeting claudin18.2 antigen in solid tumors with CT041 represents a differentiated approach for gastric and pancreatic cancers. Portfolio spans both solid tumor and hematologic applications.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 trial (NCT06560827) for CT011 in hepatocellular carcinoma and post-marketing Phase IV study for zevorcabtagene autoleucel in 2024.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Multiple programs from Phase I to Phase III, with both ex vivo CAR-T (IMC001, IMC002) and other modalities (IMV101, IMV102) in development.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Most advanced asset IMC002 has progressed to Phase III randomized trial in CLDN18.2-positive gastric adenocarcinoma as third-line therapy.
dossier.indications_pursued: Solid tumors including gastric adenocarcinoma and pancreatic cancer (CLDN18.2-positive), epithelial cancers, plus hematologic malignancies including B-cell NHL and multiple myeloma.
dossier.delivery_approach: Portfolio includes ex vivo CAR-T therapies (IMC001, IMC002) targeting solid tumors and undisclosed modalities for hematologic indications (IMV101, IMV102).
dossier.key_differentiators: Focus on CLDN18.2-targeting CAR-T for solid tumors, which represents a challenging application area for CAR-T technology with limited clinical success to date.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase III randomized trial (NCT07103668) for IMC002 in CLDN18.2-positive gastric adenocarcinoma, representing significant clinical advancement.
